review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability; this harness derives every field from the recorded log, production discovery of $CS_GAME_DIR, and a second production read of M01's wake graph — recover_retail_objectives plus the control census's own lowering on zbd/c1c/m01 (wake-graph.json). Claim is implemented only: the graph is static record evidence (the measured lifecycle model of M01-B-OBJ-1/2 and the measured gate conditions of M01-B-OBJ-3), plus driven headless runs through the production host in the acceptance suite — no original executable ran, so nothing here is verified_original runtime behaviour. MEASURED: both Finish blocks (OBJECTIVE24 INSTANTWIN, OBJECTIVE40 INSTANTLOSS) load dormant behind BEGIN_DORMANT -1, OBJECTIVE1 is the record's only armed self-wake, and every other wake is a completion effect rooted at one of the six awake-at-load blocks (2, 3, 6, 7, 36, 55), each gated on a world fact — the census asserts the whole graph edge by edge so a drift between the findings document and the record fails this run. LIMITS OF WHAT WAS MEASURED, each recorded in the findings document's Unknowns carried section: the in-play-bit writers the INACTIVE counts read are untraced world code; DEDG's member-field rewrites are a named residual the runtime does not reproduce; TRAVELERS' world-side producers are off the terminal paths and unproduced; TICK_DEPENDS_ON_OBJ's roots descend from dormant world-fact consumers. TEST-SELECTION NOTE: the prefix accept_m01_b_wake_ is unique to this task, so the 8 discovered assertions are exactly this task's tests. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
